about: Ceilings for scripts/census_python_entries_cetta.metta: calls entering project Python per scenario. Each scenario is [file, marker, ceiling] with optional mode ("probe" or "world") and an optional object of environment settings. A port lowers its ceiling; no change may raise one. One recorded re-baseline: the two-turn coding and activity delivery scenarios moved from scripted replies at the host's chat seam, which hid the provider call, onto the native transport the agents run. Each gained its two calls' four remaining host entries (36 to 44 and 34 to 42).
